title: Unity MUSE AI Now In The EDITOR!
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
With the legal greyzone around (at least) the stable diffusion capabilities, I'm actually kinda surprised they're opening up trials.

I can't deny this looks useful for those who need c# assistance or some generic textures to drop in. Animation assets may especially appeal.

As limited current genAI is, this is the worst this will ever be, its not hard to see where this is going. Interesting times.

replies.author: chillaxinbball
replies.body: There's no legal grey zone if you train the models on your own libraries or ones you licensed.

replies.author: fisj
replies.body:
Good point. I dug around a bit and found their blog post with some details:

https://blog.unity.com/engine-platform/responsible-ai-and-enhanced-model-training

They trained bespoke models on licensed and owned datasets. I think this might be the first model thats verified to be commercially usable for game content generation?

replies.author: chillaxinbball
replies.body: Adobe's models are made in the same way.

replies.body:
